name: Tulungagung
registryBasis: The official Indonesian ATR/BPN Tulungagung office portal is on the ministry's `atrbpn.go.id` domain. The official Tulungagung government reports joint local land-certificate/complete-systematic-registration (PTSL) work with Kantor Pertanahan/BPN Kabupaten Tulungagung and names the office head. This confirms a local land-registration authority, but no anonymous parcel geometry service or allowlisted geometry/ID schema was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official Kantah subdomain returns only a JavaScript-app shell in the accessible page view. The municipality's Setunggal portal describes a general one-map geographic-information service, but no cadastral parcel schema was exposed in the inspected page. The official local PBB-P2 portal is a taxpayer-specific bill and record service: it requests an NOP and presents taxpayer name, account/payment details and requests NIK/name/address/phone for copies; no form was submitted and no tax record was queried. ATR/BPN BHUMI's generic help says its data catalog may include land parcels but does not establish Tulungagung coverage or expose a safe field allowlist. No parcel features were requested.
scopeLimits: No owner, address, taxpayer, title, parcel-key, account, or protected property-record lookup was performed. No geometry or attributes were retained.
remainingUncertainty: City-specific land registration is established, but no public, TLS-protected parcel dataset with a documented geometry+stable-ID-only allowlist was located. The official municipal one-map and national BHUMI portals may contain other spatial layers, but the reviewed public descriptions do not establish a safe city parcel feature route. Taxpayer/account interfaces are excluded.
